patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — 8x8 documents a broader use-case set; Microsoft Teams is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose 8x8 only if your buying job matches “Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24” rather than Microsoft Teams's shape. Choose Microsoft Teams only if your buying job matches “M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on ” rather than 8x8's shape. Workflow advantage: 8x8 leans business-phone, sales-calling; Microsoft Teams leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — 8x8 documents a broader use-case set; Microsoft Teams is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: 8x8 is Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24/user/month annual; CC tiers custom/higher.; Microsoft Teams is M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on — free Teams tier exists; Phone Standard ~$10/user.
- Workflow coverage skew: 8x8-leaning business-phone, sales-calling, contact-center vs Microsoft Teams-leaning —.
- Researched limits: 8x8 — Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Microsoft Teams — Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job.

Limitations — 8x8: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Mandatory regulatory/service fees frequently sit on top of list seats; Microsoft Teams: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job; Teams Phone requires an eligible Teams/M365 licence plus PSTN (PAYG or Calling Plan).

Poor-fit cases: 8x8 is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated · Microsoft Teams is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job · Avoid 8x8 if you actually need Microsoft Teams's motion (M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telepho)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
